extension.summary: Slime mould, flocking birds and Particle Life in one world, for 32-bit Android Kodi
extension.description:
The same Emergence screensaver as "Emergence (OpenGL)", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a), as on many Fire TV sticks, Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV. Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app; install "Emergence (OpenGL)" on 64-bit Android and macOS.
The Physarum slime mould, the Dancing Boids flock and Particle Life's colour cells share one screen, alone or coupled: the flock lays scent that the slime grows along (Slime highways), the particle cells feed the slime (Cell garden), the flock swims round the cells (Reef), or all three at once (Ecosystem). Scenes rotate with a fade every few minutes.
This build starts at the Low detail level for a small box: 80 to 150 thousand slime agents on a 640 x 360 trail, 900 to 1,500 birds and 1,200 to 2,000 particles. The scenes, couplings, looks, detail level, speed and threads are all in the add-on settings.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on: it is built per platform and Kodi version (this one: Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android). It needs OpenGL ES 2.0.
